name: listing-troubleshooter
description: Top-level entry point for any "something's wrong with my listing" question. Does a quick scan to read the listing's status and issues, identifies the symptom, and routes the seller to the right specialist skill — issue-fixing, buyability, searchability, or compliance. Triggers on: something's wrong with my listing, troubleshoot my listing, my product has a problem, listing not working, where do I start, "can I list this", "what do I need to sell X". Routes to: listing-issues, listing-buyability, listing-searchability, listing-compliance.
